phrases: add an event to my calendar
put this event in my calendar
remove an event from my calendar
commands.prompt: This command structure is to create events for a calendar. The action refers to either adding(add), editing(edit) or removing(remove) an event and is required if remove or edit is requested you will be provided with the names of all the current events to find the best match which you will return the title by itself. Alert and second alert are both optional and they both represent the number of minutes before the event of which the person wants to be alerted. Title field is required as you cannot enter an event with no name. The start_date is a datetime formatted string that refer to the first instance of the event and there for are required. All others fields are not required and if they are not provided it will be assumed it is a one time event. The end_date is a datetime format string that is the last known instance of the event if there is one if not and repeats is set it will continue virtually forever. Frequency defaults to none as it is not required and it sets the event to spawn until the end date if given forever if not based on daily, biweekly, trimonthly, etc... Each dow fields just refers to the day of the week on which the event will spawn with the list being 7 days long starting at sunday, for if someone wants more granular control like exercise every monday and thursday would make monday(1) and thursday(5) true bools with a the given frequency(defaults to weekly if none is given and list is filled out). summary field as always is just any description or additional notes the creator wants to add to his event to be repeated back to him upon the reminder
